title: Six Hours and One Foggy Platform
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（社会服务与人际沟通·交通与出行）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（社会服务与人际沟通·交通与出行）　|　核心词汇：delay　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 delay 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the stationmaster ① announced a delay that no passenger on the platform would have forgiven, and he said the announcing was the whole of the duty. The ② delay, meaning the waiting and not the lateness, ran six hours and stayed unexplained on the board; a delay, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unannounced.

Every ③ delay in that station had the same foggy platform at the end of it, and the ④ delay at the end, meaning the one they kept for the night train and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever complained about twice. A delay, his porter said, is nine parts fog and one part somebody willing to explain; the stationmaster said the explaining is the part that fills six hours.

The timetable clerk meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the delay was the whole of the schedule, meaning the lateness and not the waiting. The ⑥ delay, meaning the lateness and not any of that, is the only thing in a schedule that everybody records and nobody allows; delay, he said, is either something you announce or the only word that means both a waiting and a lateness. He said the lateness is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ delay had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the foggy platform. The ⑧ delay of the whole thing, the stationmaster wrote in November, was one station and six hours of explaining; delay, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to explain. She said the explaining was never mentioned.

The ⑨ delay I remember is the one at the end, which was cleared in 1973 and is still described as the longest in the station. A ⑩ delay, the porter said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being explained; every delay, she said, is a lateness that has agreed to look like a waiting. She said the lateness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 延误；耽搁（指车站里发生的那一次）
B. n. 耽搁（指那段等待本身，与那个晚点相对）
C. 固定搭配：announce a delay 通告一次延误
D. n. 延误（指夜班车的那一次）
E. n. 延误；耽搁（抽象总称，指一座车站的全部晚点）
F. n. 延误（指日志里记入、被登记的那一次）
G. n. 晚点；迟到（指时刻表上被记录的迟到量）
H. n. 晚点（抽象总称，指人人记录却无人容许的那一档）

items.q: announced a delay that no passenger on the platform would have forgiven
The delay, meaning the waiting and not the lateness
the delay was the whole of the schedule
the delay had become a line in a logbook
The delay of the whole thing
A delay, the porter said in 1975

answers.why: announce a delay 意为“通告一次延误”，1952 年站长通告了一次站台上没有一位乘客肯原谅的延误。
delay 意为“耽搁”，指那段等待本身而不是那个晚点，它在公告板上挂了六个小时而无人解释。
delay 意为“延误”，指那座车站里每一次延误，每一次末尾都是同一个雾中的站台。
delay 意为“延误”，指夜班车的那一次，是唯一有人投诉过两次的。
delay 意为“晚点、迟到”，指时刻表上被记录的迟到量，时刻表员说这晚点就是那份时刻表的全部。
delay 意为“晚点”，指人人记录却无人容许的那一档而不是那段等待，是时刻表里人人都记录、却无人容许的东西。
delay 意为“延误”，指日志里记入、被登记的那一次，到 1960 年这次延误成了日志里的一行。
delay 意为“延误、耽搁”，站长十一月写道，整件事的延误是一座车站和六个小时的解释。
delay 意为“延误”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1973 年解除，至今仍被说成车站里最长的一次。
delay 为抽象总称，搬运工 1975 年说，一次延误是唯一会因为被解释而变得更好的东西。
